From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orchardbank.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: artifacts & SIG mapping after last-week outage

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Orchard Bank is beginning our internal review of the transient auth outage that affected the new KYC ingest pipeline on 24 March. As part of our SIG and due-diligence checklist, we need the following items from Redwood:

- Incident timeline covering 24–25 Mar (UTC), with who did what and when (high level is fine).
- Forensic event log excerpts for the window 2027-03-24 01:00:00Z - 2027-03-24 06:00:00Z.
- An updated SIG mapping for the controls called out in section 3.2 of our questionnaire (we flagged "Auth failover" and "Token handling").
- Confirmation of whether any customer PII was present in logs and what redaction/retention steps were taken.

We appreciate redaction where needed; a redacted timeline and logs are acceptable. Can you confirm an ETA for the artifacts and whether you can provide a short postmortem (PDF) we can reference in our internal review?

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. InfoSec Manager | Orchard Bank

Hi Elena,

Attached is a redacted postmortem (PDF) and a concise timeline CSV. We've removed customer identifiers and replaced them with stable placeholders (acct_XXXXX). Timestamps are in UTC (ISO8601).

Summary (TL;DR):
- Root cause: transient token-cache regression triggered by a weighted rollout on 2027-03-24 01:12:03Z which caused a small percentage of auth requests to fall back to a legacy handler that did not update caching headers.
- Impact: ~0.8% of KYC pipeline requests experienced elevated latency and retry storms between 01:12–01:27 UTC. No confirmed exfiltration of PII; logs contained hashed identifiers only.
- Mitigation: rollback of rollout at 01:30Z, immediate fix deployed to token handler at 02:05Z, increased monitoring and a tighter canary window.
- Next steps: formal RCA and SIG mapping (matrix) being prepared by 2027-04-02.

Attachments included: redwood_postmortem_20270331.pdf; redwood_ir_timeline.csv

If Orchard wants raw event snippets for specific trace IDs we'll need an NDA addendum (for privacy) — otherwise we can provide redacted excerpts.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
